about.title: A junior fullstack profile built around readable architecture, practical delivery, and honest technical growth.
about.intro: This portfolio is structured to make my engineering decisions visible: what problem each project solves, how I split responsibilities, where testing fits, and how I think about maintainability.
paragraphs: I am Jesus Martinez Escobar, a junior fullstack developer focused on Angular applications and Laravel-backed products. I try to write code that another developer can understand, test, and extend without needing to reverse-engineer the intent.
The projects here are presented as engineering cases: the problem, the technical decisions, the architecture, the testing approach, and the tradeoffs I would discuss in an interview.
